result.question: What plan did more than forty men present to the chief priests and elders?
result.answer: They asked them to have Paul brought before the Sanhedrin on the pretext of examining his case so they could kill him on the way.
result.reason: The first window supports the original intended fact but specifies more than forty men, not exactly forty. The repair corrects that premise and restores the omitted elders while preserving the original answer scope.
